en.summary: Trade.com is a trade name of Lead Capital Global Ltd, a Mauritius-licensed CFD broker offering forex, indices, shares and crypto CFDs.
pros: Entity appears on the Mauritius FSC register of licensees as an Investment Dealer (Broker)
Silver account from $100 and spreads advertised from 0.3 pips
MetaTrader 5 and a proprietary app available
cons: Regulated by an offshore regulator only; the site states no investor compensation scheme is in place
Site lists FCA, CySEC and FINRA numbers, but the number shown for the FCA (738538) belongs to a different firm on the FCA register, and the site says it does not serve UK or EU residents
Founding year and maximum leverage are not stated
Different registration numbers appear in different sections of the website
en.body:
## Regulation and safety

Trade.com is a trade name of Lead Capital Global Ltd, incorporated in Mauritius. The Mauritius FSC register of licensees lists Lead Capital Global Limited as an Investment Dealer (Broker) with a licence date of 2 March 2020 (checked 2026-11-12).

The website's footer also shows UK FCA, CySEC and US FINRA/SEC numbers. We could not match these to Lead Capital Global: searching the FCA reference the site shows (738538) returned a different firm. The site also states that it does not serve UK, EU, Swiss or US residents and that no investor compensation system applies. We therefore treat the FSC licence as the only relevant authorisation and do not list the others.

## Trading conditions

The Silver account starts at $100, Gold at $10,000 and the top tier at $100,000+. Spreads are advertised from 0.3 pips. The number of instruments is given as 850+ in one place and 1,200+ in another. Maximum leverage and founding year are not stated on the pages we read.

## Platforms

MetaTrader 5 (including a macOS version), WebTrader and the TRADE mobile app.

## Who is it for?

Traders comfortable with offshore regulation who want a mid-sized CFD range. Check the legal entity and regulation page for your country before opening an account. CFDs carry a high risk of loss.

ja.body:
## 規制と安全性

Trade.comはモーリシャス法人Lead Capital Global Ltdの屋号です。モーリシャスFSCの登録簿には、Lead Capital Global LimitedがInvestment Dealer (Broker)として2020年3月2日付で記載されています（確認日 2026-11-12）。

サイトのフッターにはFCA・CySEC・FINRA/SECの番号も表示されていますが、Lead Capital Globalとの一致は確認できませんでした。FCA番号（738538）を検索すると別の会社が該当しました。またサイトは英国・EU・スイス・米国の居住者を対象外とし、投資家補償制度もないと述べています。そのため、FSCのライセンスのみを有効なものとして扱っています。

## 取引条件

Silver口座は100ドル、Gold口座は1万ドル、最上位は10万ドル以上です。スプレッドは0.3pipsからと案内されています。取扱銘柄数は850以上と1,200以上の2通りの記載があります。最大レバレッジと設立年は確認したページには記載がありませんでした。

## 取引プラットフォーム

MetaTrader 5（macOS版を含む）、WebTrader、TRADEモバイルアプリです。

## どんな人に向いているか

オフショア規制を理解したうえで、中規模のCFD商品群を求める方向けです。口座開設前に居住国向けの法人・規制情報を確認してください。CFDは損失リスクが高い商品です。
